draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 154th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 21st of 37 at CB. He went 178th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Will Redmond. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (13th percentile), three-cone (8th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 1st in passes defended among the 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 37 career games and 2 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile), season snap share 12.1% (19th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2024.
